capabilities: Render notes as a 3D tree of light with leaves placed by field and time
Arrange top-level folders as an independent forest of trees with bridge notes between them
Cluster linked dots and mark flowers (ah-ha moments), apples (outputs), and seeds
Open note cards from dots and hand-place dots within their field wedges
Render from YAML frontmatter, with or without an AI companion
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin: it renders the 3D tree only and ships no AI of its own; the companion 'tree team' is a separate download run through Claude Code.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only due to heavy WebGL. Distributed via GitHub releases with a starter vault; live auto-refresh of note changes is still on the roadmap, so trees need manual reloading.
problem: Obsidian's flat file lists and abstract graph give no spatial, metaphorical view of how ideas in different topics relate and grow over time.

relations.evidence: Open the same folder with Claude Code and say "Gardener, let's think."
3D "tree of light" view (three.js) in a locked warm-white observatory aesthetic

summary: Renders notes as an interactive 3D tree of light, where folders become trees, notes become leaves placed by field and time, and links become connections.
